clues.text: A poet from what is now this country is the subject of the Eliot Weinberger workNineteen Ways of Looking athim, which describes the twenty-character-longpoem "Deer Grove."
The protagonist of a novel from this country has a vision of the Twelve Beauties, and is born with a precious stone in his mouth.
In a novel from this country, a character decides to urinate on pillars that turn out to be the fingers of a god.
In another novel from this country, one character wields an iron rake, while another character was born from a stone egg.
In another novel from this country, a character “borrows” 100,000 arrows using straw boats in preparation for the Battle of Red Cliffs.
A poem from this country describes "bowing my head" and "frost upon the ground".
"Drinking Alone by Moonlight" and "Quiet Night Thought" are by a poet from this country.
Romance of the Three Kingdoms and Journey to the West are two of the Four Great Classics written in what country home to the poet Li Bai that was formerly ruled by the Ming Dynasty?
The Monkey King, Sun Wukong (woo-kohng), appears in a novel from what country where Li Bai wrote during the Tang Dynasty?
The Four Classics are novels from what large Asian country?

answerlines: China [or People’s Republic of China or PRC or Zhōngguó; accept Táng dynasty]
China [or Zhōngguó or People’s Republic of China or PRC or Zhōnghuá Rénmín Gònghéguó; accept Tang China or Tang dynasty or Tang Empire] (The third line clues “Drinking Alone by Moonlight.”)

clues.text: An author from this country wrote about a childhood in the “Slaughterhouse Village” in his novel Pow!
A poet from this modern-day country wrote “In a dismal storm an old tree is the best place to be” after his “thatched hut” was blown away by heavy winds.
A novel from this country includes an agreement that ends, “may heaven and the people of the earth both strike us dead.”
In a novel from this country, “I” travels to the country after a false cancer diagnosis and meets “You,” who is looking for the title Soul Mountain.
The Good Earth is set in this country, as is another novel where Sandy and Pigsy accompany a monk on his pilgrimage.
The speaker drinks “A cup of wine, under the flowering trees” and concludes that “the moon, alas, is no drinker of wine” in a poem from this country.
“Earthly Fiends” are described in a novel from this country about the 108 Heroes.
This country’s Four Great Classics include Water Margin and Journey to the West.
Name this country, the home of the authors of Journey to the West and Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
“Quiet Night Thoughts” is by a poet from what home country of Dù Fǔ and Lǐ Bái?

answerlines: China [or Zhōngguó; accept Tang dynasty or Táng cháo] (The first poem is “Jade Flower Palace” and the second is “Song of the Wagons,” both by Du Fu)
China [or Zhongguo; or Zhonghua Renmin Gongheguo; or the People's Republic of China]

clues.text: One novel from this modern country centers on a "ghost caught in Individualism's blind alley", a peasant nicknamed "Camel" who moves to the capital to work.
This country’s 20th-century history is retold in reverse chronology in a story from the recent collection Broken Stars.
The speaker of a poem from this country laments “sons… buried amid the grass” in a poem whose title vehicles “rumble and roll.”
An author from this country wrote a novella whose title character tries to draw a perfect circle and declares things "spiritual victories."

"White bones" lying "on the shores of the Kokonor" are described in a poem from this country, also the origin of poem in which a "westward voyager" is asked "when will you come back" from a voyage whose difficulty is compared to "climbing the sky."
Found in the collection Call to Arms, the narrator of a story from this country wishes to “save the children” after thinking he’s in a town full of cannibals.
The author of “A Madman’s Diary” and “The True Story of Ah Q” championed this country's New Culture Movement, while its only Nobel Laureate wrote the play Bus Stop and the novel Soul Mountain.
clues.source: 2010 PACE NSC, Packet 24 Tie Breaker III
